description_en: Configures the IP blacklist and whitelist for a website
description_zh: 设置针对网站业务的黑名单和白名单IP
name: ConfigWebIpSet

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group in Resource Management to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance is added to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A website forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The list of IP addresses or address segments to add to the blacklist. You can add up to 200 IP addresses or address segments
parameters.help_zh: 黑名单IP地址/地址段列表。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个黑名单IP地址/地址段
parameters.name: black_list

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses or CIDR blocks for the whitelist. You can add up to 200 IP addresses or CIDR blocks
parameters.help_zh: 白名单IP地址/地址段列表。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个白名单IP地址/地址段
parameters.name: white_list
